comments.body: As of today, I think the Google Doc (while nowhere near any definition of "finished") is rich and interesting enough to move discussion to the main wiki page for the Versioning API.
This is a great start. Let's move the discussion to the community with the goal of transitioning the document to a more public location, using https://www.w3.org/respec/?
ReSpec, as I understand it, requires a repository for the source HTML of the document being edited. Do we have a location for that yet?

I could see potentially creating a new GitHub repository inside the fcrepo4 organization for specs:
https://github.com/fcrepo4

It would be good to first verify that Git is an effective source for ReSpec, however, before creating a new repo.
If we do go with a Github base, I think we want a different org. Not fcrepo4, maybe fcrepo plain or something else.
That is interesting. Would you mind expanding on why you think the central org for current Fedora work (i.e. fcrepo4) is not well-suited as a home for the API specification?
Because it has a version number in it, Andrew Woods.

Resolved with:
https://github.com/fcrepo/fcrepo-specification/
and
http://fedora.info/spec/resource-versioning
